summary: The agent formulates a functional regression pipeline with LightGBM and implements decent date-based feature engineering. However, it suffers from critical data leakage by computing imputation medians and frequency encoding on the combined train and test set prior to splitting. Furthermore, it completely ignores the inherent temporal structure of the data by using a random K-Fold split, risking significant look-ahead bias.
